Emergency Obs. Request Information

  • Disaster Type: Oil and Chemical spill
  • Country/Region: India

Disaster Situation

There has been a capsizing of the MSC ELSA 3 vessel approximately 14.6 nautical miles off the coast of Thottappally on May 25, 2025, near Kerala coast, India resulting in ongoing oil and chemical spill posing a significant threat to the marine and coastal environment.
